mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Joraga Invocation {4}{G}{G} Sorcery
# "Each creature you control gets +3/+3 until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able."
# +3/+3: the compiler's B4-modify-pt-eot-you shape ("Creatures you control get +3/+3 until end of
# turn." parses to it; "each creature you control" is the same population).
# "must be blocked this turn if able": Canopy Stalker's MANDATE_BLOCK (B4-must-block) over the same
# population, with duration=DurationEot() ("this turn"; the dispatch honours it since B-59).
_yours = Selector(
    count=QUnbounded(),
    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        ),
    ),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                    'duration': DurationEot(),
                    'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=3)),
                    'target': _yours,
                    'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=3)),
                }),
                A(Verb.MANDATE_BLOCK, {'cards': _yours, 'duration': DurationEot()}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Each creature you control gets +3/+3 until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
clauses.ir: abilities[0].effect.steps[0] (+3/+3 until end of turn), abilities[0].effect.steps[1] (must be blocked this turn)

g0_warnings: component shapes no compiled card has (review them in the probe): atom MANDATE_BLOCK(cards,duration)
mapping.notes: Was needs-atom (MANDATE_BLOCK ignored its duration); B-59 fixed the dispatch, so 'must be blocked this turn' is MANDATE_BLOCK with DurationEot (Canopy Stalker's verb) after the compiler's B4-modify-pt-eot-you +3/+3. G0 flags MANDATE_BLOCK(cards,duration) as a composition no compiled card has. Self-check packs: the wall is forced to block this turn and free two turns later (a no-duration draft fails the second).
